risks.proof: Close-up photos of each blade surface.

risks.risk: The oscillation mechanism may be broken or seized.

proof_requests: Video of the fan powered on and oscillating.
Close-up photos of the blades to check for cracks or splinters.
Photo of the manufacturer's label on the motor housing to confirm the model and wattage.
response.reason: The item is a standard standing fan. While the seller's claim of 'brand new' is unproven, it can be priced at its worst-case value as a used, non-functional unit.
